subject: Your 68-day sound journey
preview_text: A personal thank you and exclusive access only for long-term users like you.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago, you downloaded Loud EQ. Since then, you've been hearing your commute differently—no more straining, no more distortion. That matters to us.

We built this app for people like you: commuters, podcast lovers, drivers who just want to hear clearly. You've stuck with us, and that's rare. So here's something only long-term users get: exclusive insider access to our Sound DNA feature.

Sound DNA learns your exact hearing profile and tunes every source—Spotify, Audible, calls—around your ears. It's the most personal boost we can offer, and it's only unlocked for those who've been with us this long. Open the app, go to Profile, and tap 'Sound DNA.' It's your gift.

No upsell, no strings. Just a thank you. Open Loud EQ now and claim your Sound DNA profile. P.S. If you've already tried it, skip the carousel and use 'One-tap Optimize' with your next pair of headphones—it auto-tunes around that specific device.
